report.advertisedClaim: The advertised claim is unverified on the offer page: Delta says there are no change fees, so I can cancel my Basic Economy ticket any time for a full cash refund.
report.policyFinding: Delta's published policy states that Basic Economy (Main Basic) tickets are non-refundable after the 24-hour risk-free cancellation period. If you cancel after this period, you will not receive a cash refund; instead, you may receive an eCredit minus cancellation fees, or in some cases, no value at all. Full cash refunds are only available within 24 hours of purchase or for refundable tickets.
report.explanation: The user claim is contradicted by Delta's official policy. Basic Economy tickets are non-refundable after the 24-hour risk-free cancellation period. Canceling a Basic Economy ticket after this window does not entitle you to a full cash refund; at best, you may receive an eCredit minus fees, and in some cases, no value. Only refundable tickets or cancellations within 24 hours of purchase are eligible for a full cash refund.
importantConditions: Basic Economy tickets are non-refundable after 24 hours from purchase.
Within 24 hours of purchase, all tickets (including Basic Economy) can be canceled for a full cash refund.
After 24 hours, canceling a Basic Economy ticket may result in an eCredit minus cancellation fees, not a cash refund.
If you do not cancel before departure, the ticket has no remaining value.

evidence.excerpt: Note: Customers who purchase Delta Main Basic (Basic Economy) will not be able to change or refund their ticket after the Risk-Free Cancellation period.
Classic and Basic tickets are nonrefundable. Please be sure to cancel your flight prior to departure. Non-refundable tickets not changed or canceled prior to departure will have no remaining value.
If your plans change and you booked a non-refundable ticket, you can cancel your ticket for an eCredit minus any applicable cancellation fees.

As part of our Customer Commitment for customers who book direct on delta.com or the Fly Delta app, Risk-Free Cancellation means that after you’ve purchased a qualifying eTicket, you have up to 24 hours after booking to cancel it for any reason and receive a full refund with no fees.

unansweredQuestions: What are the exact cancellation fees for Basic Economy tickets on specific routes?
Are there any exceptions for cash refunds on Basic Economy tickets due to extraordinary circumstances (e.g., illness, schedule change)?
nextSteps: If you purchased your Basic Economy ticket within the last 24 hours, cancel immediately to receive a full cash refund.
If more than 24 hours have passed, check if you are eligible for an eCredit and what cancellation fees apply.
Review your ticket type and cancellation options in your Delta 'My Trips' account.
Contact Delta customer service if you believe you qualify for an exception (e.g., significant schedule change, illness).
